description: Create a delivery address (place of business) for this customer — required once before the first order, exactly as the web shop asks right after registration. Minimum: city, zip, house number, a contact surname and a phone for the carrier; street may be empty in villages without street names. Leave the address fields empty to deliver to the registered company address from ARES (city, zip, street and house number are then copied from the account). Input is tidied automatically (phone prefix, zip spacing); only what cannot be fixed is refused. Payment terms of the address follow the customer account; the payment of a particular order is chosen in place_order. Returns delivery_address_id for checkout_preview and place_order.

contact_surname.description: Who receives the goods — printed for the carrier

delivery_method_id.description: Default transport for this address; TOPTRANS courier when omitted

email.description: E-mail of the delivery place only when it differs from the account e-mail

place_name.description: Name of the shop / production site, defaults to the company name

name: create_delivery_address
title: Add delivery address
